findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which increases the risk associated with long-term use of the same cryptographic key material and weakens the encryption posture over time.

No key policy is defined for the KMS key, meaning it will fall back to the default policy that grants full access to the entire AWS account via IAM, potentially allowing overly broad access to the key used for encrypting logs.
